Blocks.Text: This page provides a comprehensive guide on migrating customer jobs from scraped jobs to API job postings. It outlines the requirements and steps involved in the migration process, ensuring a smooth transition for customers. Additionally, the guide emphasizes the importance of a validation strategy, specifically the Parity Check process, which ensures the accuracy and integrity of job data before customers are "cutover" to API job postings. By following this guide, customers can seamlessly migrate their jobs and leverage the benefits of the API for enhanced job management and visibility.

When development has been completed for a LinkedIn Job Posting integration, customers enabling the integration will be subject to a "Parity Check" process. This process will monitor readiness of the API jobs being received compared to a customer's already posted scraped jobs. LinkedIn will measure customer eligibility for customer using a few different metrics:

Job Matching Rate: the number of scraped jobs paired to API jobs divided by the number of scraped jobs.
Data Parity Rate: the number of API jobs that have exact match of job title, job description, and job location divided by the number of API jobs that has a paired job.
Your Partner Solutions Engineer or Business Development contact will share reporting to assist resolving identified issues.

Customers who have met LinkedIn's parity check metrics (Job Matching Rate > 95% & Data Parity Rate > 90%) customer's will be automatically cutover to API jobs, disabling legacy scraped methods for job postings. Once all customers have been cutover to API jobs partners may begin deprecating legacy methods of job posting ie. bulk XML feeds.
